verdict.rationale: Notion is a workspace and knowledge-management product, not an AI coding agent, so restoring a coding agent's session to a prior checkpoint is outside its product category. Its Agent APIs let you read a session's event history, but there is no evidence of a coding agent or of checkpoint restore, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
